name: piecyfer-behaviour-tool
description: Record and diff what the site DOES, not what it looks like. Companion to ../pixel-tool, which is blind to behaviour.
//dependencies: Deliberately EMPTY. Playwright is resolved from ../pixel-tool/node_modules
by an explicit relative require in run.js, so there is no npm install step
here and no second 300MB Chromium download.
The reason is not disk space. Two independent installs drift onto two
different Chromium builds, and at that point 'the behaviour changed' and
'the browser changed' become impossible to tell apart. Sharing one install
means both harnesses always report on the same browser.
If ../pixel-tool/node_modules is ever missing, run `npm install` in
_project/pixel-tool; run.js exits 2 with that instruction rather than
